# Stage reference

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_stage_docs.py — do not edit by hand -->

23 stages are registered. A pipeline is an ordered list of these; the
runner validates the plane chain (`imgen validate pipelines/x.json`) before running.

**Planes**: `rgb` (sRGB [0,1]) → `semantic` (scene-linear highlight field) →
`highlight` ([0,1] resolved light fraction) → `nits` (cd/m²) → `scrgb` (1.0 = 80 cd/m²).

## Summary

| stage | kind | requires | produces | needs | description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `analyze.stats` | sink | rgb | — | — | Write a JSON report: SDR stats, HDR luminance distribution, pipeline passes. |
| `analyze.crops` | sink | rgb | — | — | Write 1:1 crop pairs (reference \| result) for the given anchors, plus a combined sheet. |
| `analyze.sheet` | sink | — | — | — | Build a labelled contact sheet from any list of image files (paths may contain {out}/{work}). |
| `deband.gradient` | process | rgb | rgb | — | Four-direction gradient deband with optional dither (pure numpy). |
| `deband.ffmpeg` | process | rgb | rgb | ffmpeg | Deband through ffmpeg (gradfun / deband). gradfun is 8-bit only. |
| `denoise.nlmeans` | process | rgb | rgb | — | Luma NL-means (non-local means). Hue-preserving; best applied before upscaling. |
| `denoise.bilateral` | process | rgb | rgb | — | Fast small-kernel bilateral filter on luma (edge preserving, no ringing). |
| `denoise.ffmpeg` | process | rgb | rgb | ffmpeg | Denoise through ffmpeg (hqdn3d / nlmeans presets). 8-bit PNG intermediate. |
| `encode.float` | sink | scrgb | — | — | Write the scRGB plane as packed float32 (.f32) or a numpy array (.npy) for other encoders. |
| `encode.jxr` | sink | scrgb | — | jxr | Encode scRGB to .jxr (64bppRGBAHalf/scRGB) via WIC and verify the decode. |
| `hdr.semantic.load` | process | — | semantic | — | Load a cached semantic highlight map (.npy, scene-linear float). |
| `hdr.semantic.identity` | process | rgb | semantic | — | No model: derive a highlight signal analytically from the source luma (fallback / baseline). |
| `hdr.semantic.external` | process | rgb | semantic | — | Run an external semantic-HDR model (LumiPic / FLUX-class LoRA) and cache its .npy output. |
| `hdr.map` | process | rgb, semantic | nits, scrgb, highlight | — | Map a semantic highlight signal to absolute luminance and scRGB (the core SDR->HDR step). |
| `hdr.preview` | sink | scrgb | — | — | Write an SDR inspection preview (Reinhard on paper white) and the highlight map. |
| `io.load` | source | — | rgb | — | Read an image (PNG/JPEG/WebP/BMP/TIFF) into the rgb plane. Uses --input when path is empty. |
| `io.crop` | process | rgb | rgb | — | Crop the rgb plane (width/height 0 = to the edge). Derived planes are dropped. |
| `io.resize` | process | rgb | rgb | — | Resize the rgb plane. Give width+height, or long_edge, or scale (0 = unused). |
| `io.save` | sink | rgb | — | — | Write the rgb plane (PNG is lossless; JPEG/WebP use `quality`). |
| `sharpen.unsharp` | process | rgb | rgb | — | Unsharp mask on luma. `threshold` (in 0-1 units) protects smooth areas from noise amplification. |
| `sharpen.highpass` | process | rgb | rgb | — | Add a blurred high-pass layer (soft local contrast, no edge overshoot control). |
| `upscale.ncnn` | process | rgb | rgb | ncnn | Upscale with an ncnn-vulkan binary (realesrgan \| realcugan \| waifu2x). Repeat the stage to chain passes. |
| `upscale.onnx` | process | rgb | rgb | onnx | Tiled ONNX super-resolution with feathered (seam-free) blending. |
